text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's time for training, but Symboli<n>Rudolf is nowhere
to be found.<n>Curious, I make my way to the<n>student
council office.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I find her dozing amid<n>stacks of
paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No... I don't need that chair moved...<n>Heh... Chair
move... Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's sleeping<n>peacefully, so I decide
not to disturb<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please accept my earnest apologies<n>for failing to
keep to our schedule.
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I will take pains to ensure<n>that this does
not happen again.
